question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR builder, confirm the mapping of the five status-select labels "On track / Watch / Off track / Tracking / WIP" to the existing MetricStatus enum (positive/warning/negative/neutral/wip) and that the off-track marker uses an X shape (via src/lib/status) distinct from the on-track filled circle without relying on colour.
recommendation: The label-to-enum mapping is confirmed and correct (positive=On track, warning=Watch, negative=Off track, neutral=Tracking, wip=WIP), but the off-track marker does NOT use an X shape — it is currently a solid diamond. If an X is required, change STATUS_META.negative.shape to 'x' in src/lib/status.ts, add a matching .status-dot--x rule in styles.css, and update the shape tests; otherwise keep the existing diamond, which already provides a colour-independent silhouette distinct from the on-track filled circle.
supporting_points: Mapping confirmed: STATUS_META in src/lib/status.ts (typed as Record<MetricStatus, StatusMeta>) sets positive→'On track', warning→'Watch', negative→'Off track', neutral→'Tracking', wip→'WIP'; MbrBuilderView.tsx renders the select options directly from STATUS_META so the five labels match the enum in shared/types.ts (positive|warning|negative|neutral|wip) one-to-one.

Shape is a colour-independent silhouette field ('circle'|'triangle'|'diamond'|'ring'|'half-circle') that drives a .status-dot--<shape> class; on-track (positive) is 'circle' (a filled currentColor disc) and off-track (negative) is 'diamond' (a filled clip-path rhombus in styles.css), so the two are already distinguishable without relying on colour — but the off-track marker is a diamond, not an X.

No 'x' shape exists anywhere: src/lib/status.ts, src/lib/status.shape.test.ts (which asserts negative.shape === 'diamond'), and styles.css (.status-dot--diamond) contain no X marker or .status-dot--x rule, so the premise that off-track 'uses an X shape' is not currently true and would require a code change to become so.
